Select IC50 activity records for target CHEMBL335 with compound structures and publication provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL335 and standard_type IC50. Require non-null canonical_smiles and pubmed_id_or_doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
